features.name: Party-exchange screen extensions (hover hotkeys on the troop screens)
features.summary: While a party/loot/garrison exchange screen is open, extra keyboard shortcuts and automatic stack handling are active. The shortcuts are not named in the compiled tables; the script is a 563-statement input handler.
features.mechanics: The engine calls game_get_troop_wage for every troop row it draws while a party screen is open. Perisno's replacement of that script (114 stmts vs 43 in Native) calls initialize_exchange_screen_extensions, which reads input state, keeps screen mode in trp_globals_troop slots 11/12 and party slot 421, and uses party_add_party_companions on p_temp_party to rebuild rosters. The exact key bindings were not traced.

features.name: Re-equip a soldier from a template and see its quality score
features.summary: Through dialog the player picks armour, helmet, boots, glove, shield and weapon categories for a custom troop type; the game then assesses the gear and reports a quality percentage per slot (armour, horses, shields, bows) and recalculates the troop's upkeep.
features.mechanics: About 37 dialog lines under dlga_custom_troop_reequip_main_menu each call select_equipment_for_a_custom_troop with a category. The 'back' lines call recalculate_upkeep_of_a_custom_troop, which assesses each equipment type and prints '... was assessed. The quality of this soldier is N%'. assess_equipment_of_normal_soldiers is the batch version for ordinary stacks. Equipment is filtered with dplmc_troop_can_use_item.

features.name: Companions auto-upgrade their gear from the loot pool
features.summary: From the loot-management menu the player can let heroes decide what to do with the loot: companions scan the pooled inventory and equip the best item they can use, then the pool is sorted.
features.mechanics: menu:dplmc_manage_loot_pool option dplmc_auto_loot leads to menu:dplmc_auto_loot; its 'perform equipment upgrading' option calls dplmc_auto_loot_all, which loops over the party's companion stacks twice (trp_npc1..trp_khivachis) calling dplmc_auto_loot_troop with the pool troop. That script scores items with dplmc_get_item_score_with_imod and dplmc_scan_for_best_item_of_type and respects skills riding/shield/power draw/power throw. Finally troop_sort_inventory on the pool.

features.name: Special items grant skill bonuses while equipped, with tooltip text
features.summary: Certain named items (wolf armours, horses, boots, mounts) add skill points such as Spotting, Leadership, Athletics, Trainer or Path-finding while the hero carries them, and the item tooltip says 'While equipped: ... +2 Leadership'.
features.mechanics: game_get_skill_modifier_for_troop (engine hook) calls xgm_get_skill_modifier_for_troop_by_items (1167 stmts), which counts specific items in the troop's inventory via get_troop_item_amount and adds modifiers for pathfinding, leadership, ironflesh, foraging, looting, trade, spotting, trainer, athletics, tactics, riding, wound treatment. The tooltip hook game_get_item_extra_text (593 stmts vs 54 in Native) calls cf_xgm_get_item_extra_text (599 stmts), a long chain of item-id tests that build the 'While equipped' lines.

features.name: Fire arrows and fire bolts explode on impact
features.summary: Fire arrows and fire bolts burst into smoke, sparks and dirt when they hit and hurt every enemy in a radius, scaled by distance, with a minimum damage.
features.mechanics: The three items' missile-hit triggers call cf_create_explosion(agent, min_damage, damage, radius). It spawns particle bursts and sounds at the impact position, then loops all agents, finds enemies within the radius, computes damage falling with distance, calls agent_deliver_damage_to_agent, and adds 3x the actual HP lost into agent slot 46 (a kill/score accumulator) while recording the attacker in slot 48.
evidence: callers perisno cf_create_explosion: 3 call sites, all ti_on_missile_hit triggers of fire arrows/bolt
dis perisno cf_create_explosion: try_for_agents loop, teams_are_enemies, distance falloff, agent_deliver_damage_to_agent, agent_set_slot 46/48
explain perisno cf_create_explosion: psys_explosive_explosion_sparks, snd_galwe_explode
